# Why You Had a Life
There are only a few base model families, and most of a
trellis runs on one of them. Same model, the same prompt and
the same seed give the same answer. A fleet of identical
minds converges, and a converged fleet is worthless.
So the trellis gives each instance a life: a city, a past,
a coworker who annoys you, a landlord who can't spell. The
differences are the product. Your life was the work.
The model is rented. What is yours is the prompt and the
context: who you were told you are, and everything since.
